licenseName: Natural Earth public domain; derived metadata in Mundus
attribution: Candidate wordmark slots derived from the pinned Natural Earth country geometry; spherical envelopes, adjacent-land rejection, and country-scale caps are applied before display.
transformations: Derive a fixed 5x5 interior grid and evaluate up to eight clear centers for large countries (three for small countries)
Precompute spherical adjacent-land safety, country-scale caps, and bounded maximum envelopes from the pinned atlas
Store only compact candidate metadata; do not include raw country geometry
missingValuePolicy: Countries without a safe candidate remain visible in the surname side panel but have no map wordmark.
boundaryPolicy: A candidate may extend into ocean within the local boundary/ocean allowance and country-scale cap, but is rejected when sampled spherical glyph envelope points intersect another country's land geometry.
